title: Body Axis, Cakra & Kuṇḍalinī — Historical Layers, Spine Routes and Potatoverse Comparison
purpose: Separate South Asian tantric/haṭha-yogic cakra and kuṇḍalinī systems from modern seven-chakra popularization, neuroanatomy and Potatoverse Spine/Ladder/Eye/Spirit mappings.
epistemic_rule: Cakras and kuṇḍalinī are tradition-specific religious/yogic concepts. Nerve plexuses, endocrine organs, pineal, CSF and spinal anatomy are modern biological structures; resemblance or modern correspondence does not make them identical.

scholarly_context.kundalini_origin: Oxford Bibliographies places kuṇḍalinī in Indian tantric sources from roughly the eighth century CE, with later developments across Hindu tantra, Vajrayāna/cāṇḍālī, haṭha yoga and modern global esotericism.
scholarly_context.modern_physiology: Harvard's Center for the Study of World Religions notes that nineteenth/twentieth-century interpretations increasingly correlated cakras with nerve plexuses; this was a modern adaptation, not the starting point of tantric subtle-body systems.

structure_rules: There is no single timeless pan-Indian seven-chakra diagram.
Different tantric and yogic texts enumerate different numbers, names, petals, deities, mantras and channels.
The now-familiar seven-center ladder is an important modern/global standardization but must be labeled as such.
Kuṇḍalinī can be compared structurally with ascent/activation, but should not be reduced to a literal electrical current or CSF flow.

channels.caution: Names and roles differ by textual tradition.
channels.sushumna: central-channel comparator for project Axis/Spine, not literal spinal cord identity
channels.ida_pingala: paired side-channel comparators for alternating/polarized flow; do not force one-to-one Father/Son mapping without a source-specific reason

project_body_relations.spine: Axis/Ladder comparator; actual vertebral column remains anatomy
project_body_relations.pineal: Door/Eye comparator in project canon; biological pineal regulates melatonin/circadian timing
project_body_relations.thalamus: House comparator; actual thalamus is paired heterogeneous nuclei/relay-integration system
project_body_relations.csf: River/Spirit flow comparator; actual CSF remains physiological fluid
project_body_relations.serpent: Kuṇḍalinī serpent imagery is a South Asian historical neighbor for coiled/rising energy; biblical serpent, caduceus and Potatoverse reframing-serpent remain separate symbol lineages

failure_modes: seven modern centers presented as the universal ancient system
spiritual experience medicalized or neuroanatomy spiritualized without evidence
kuṇḍalinī called measurable electricity/frequency without validated measurement
distinct Hindu/Buddhist/yogic traditions flattened into generic New Age anatomy
